## Key Function

`domain::BattleATB_TickAndReady` (`0x4842B0`) — called from `BattleUI_InputPollAndMenuState` (`0x4A8772`) each frame.

## ATB Increment

Per-slot, per-frame:

```
base = 10  (default)
base = 15  if status_2 & 0x2  (Haste)
base = 5   if status_2 & 0x4  (Slow)

cur_atb += base * K_MISC.atb_speed_multiplier * (spd + 30) / 100
```

See also: `docs/tech/systems/battle_slot_data.md` for the full slot struct layout.

A slot is processed only when:
- `flag_data & 0x01` is set (slot is active)
- `status_1 & 0x01` is clear (not dead)
- `status_1 & 0x04` is clear (not petrified)

- `cur_atb` clamped to `max_atb`

  - `flag_data |= 0x08` (menu-ready)

## UI Mirror

const std::array<std::uint8_t, 256>& battle_random_table() noexcept {

std::uint8_t battle_rng_draw(RngState& state) noexcept {
    const std::uint8_t lane = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(state.active_lane & 7u);
    const std::uint8_t index = state.lane_index[lane];
    ++state.lane_index[lane];

void battle_rng_seed(RngState& state, std::uint8_t seed) noexcept {
    for (std::uint8_t lane = 0; lane < state.lane_index.size(); ++lane) {
        state.lane_index[lane] = seed;
        const std::uint8_t index = state.lane_index[0];
        ++state.lane_index[0];

    const std::uint8_t index = state.lane_index[0];
    ++state.lane_index[0];
    state.active_lane = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(kBattleRandomTable[index] & 7u);
}

std::uint8_t battle_rng_seed_from_holdrand(RngState& state, std::uint32_t& holdrand) noexcept {
